name: io.github.Fireiscoolsolo/canvas-lms-mcp-local
description: Student-focused Canvas LMS: 240 tools for grades, deadlines, planning, submissions and study plans.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Canvas personal access token (Account > Settings > Approved Integrations > New Access Token)

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your school's Canvas address, e.g. https://yourschool.instructure.com

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Which tools to turn on, by name or number: 1 essentials, 2 core, 3 study, 4 grades, 5 readonly, 6 full. Not set means full, every tool
